subject: JPMorgan blocks outside AI agents from operating on customer accounts
text:
Source: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/jpmorgan-ai-agents-account-access.html (also the Q3 call transcript https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/jpm/transcripts/686357-q3-2026/ and Banking Dive)
Why it fits: top beat (AI inside banks, agentic payments). Dimon said on the 13 Oct earnings call that JPMorgan won't allow just any outside agent inside the company. Several established outlets covered it, so it falls under the must-not-miss rule for a big bank's AI plans. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
